stories.title: US confirms for first time it has deployed a space weapon
stories.summary: Air Force Secretary Troy Meink said the US has placed an offensive-capable weapon in Earth orbit, the first time Washington has acknowledged deploying such capabilities, describing it as needed to safeguard US forces against evolving threats.

stories.title: 54 Saudi air strikes target Houthis as Yemen fighting rages
stories.summary: Yemen's internationally recognized government says Saudi Arabia launched dozens of air strikes on Houthi forces during their rapid advance, as oil prices rise on Gulf supply disruption fears.

stories.title: US Supreme Court rejects Trump mail ballot restrictions
stories.summary: The Supreme Court turned down President Trump's bid to restrict mail balloting for the midterms, letting states keep the long-standing processes that have accounted for nearly a third of votes cast.

stories.title: Nato jets shoot down drone violating Lithuania's airspace
stories.summary: Nato fighter jets shot down a drone near Kaunas that entered Lithuanian airspace from Belarus, while Poland scrambled its own jets after recovering a suspected Russian drone adrift in its waters.

stories.title: Trump says AI safety fears are a 'hoax' as he rejects safeguards
stories.summary: President Trump dismissed concerns about AI risks as a 'hoax', rejecting calls to slow development even as Anthropic's Dario Amodei and rivals Sam Altman and Elon Musk backed industry-wide deceleration and regulation.

stories.title: AI 'kill switch' may need to be mandatory, Anthropic co-founder tells BBC
stories.summary: Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark said a third-party-verifiable 'kill switch' may need to be mandatory for AI firms as systems become more powerful, adding to calls for safeguards from executives and staff at leading labs.

stories.title: Reports: O'Charley's to abruptly close all locations
stories.summary: The casual-dining chain O'Charley's is reportedly shutting all of its locations, years after it closed at least six Columbus and Dayton restaurants in 2023 citing 'unprecedented disruptions'.

stories.title: New ways to reach Tokyo and Europe via Columbus airport in 2027
stories.summary: American Airlines is adding international routes from Columbus's John Glenn airport to Tokyo and Europe, giving central Ohio travelers new nonstop options starting in 2027.

stories.title: Bexley to add dog-friendly outdoor expansion to The Lion
stories.summary: The Lion restaurant in Bexley will add a dog-friendly outdoor expansion, expanding capacity in the Columbus-adjacent suburb.

stories.title: Jos Verstappen opens up on Max's decision to extend Red Bull deal to 2030
stories.summary: Max Verstappen's father said his son seriously weighed quitting F1 or joining another team before re-committing to Red Bull through 2030, deciding staying felt right because he is comfortable with the team.

stories.title: Tarkov servers down for patch 1.1.5.1, adds League rank system
stories.summary: Battlestate Games took Escape from Tarkov offline on Sept 15 to install patch 1.1.5.1, which introduces a League system with weekly 50-player leaderboards, promotion/demotion and rank rewards, plus optic-aiming and Lighthouse fixes.
